page_title: NAN 0-2 PSG | Nantes v PSG 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Matthis Abline (Nantes) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker over the bar.
90+3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

90+2' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
90+1' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.

89' Moses Simon (Nantes) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the left side of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma made a superb athletic save to deny him.
87' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
85' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
79' Jocelyn Gourvennec decides to make a substitution. Moussa Sissoko will be replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
79' Today's match ends for Marcus Coco who will be replaced by Matthis Abline (Nantes).
78' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Remy Descamps into right side of the goal.
77' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
77' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
76' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Jerome Brisard signals a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for PSG.
74' Jocelyn Gourvennec prepares a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed is replaced by Moses Simon (Nantes).

70' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Gianluigi Donnarumma anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
70' Substitution. Marquinhos walks off the pitch and Lucas Beraldo (PSG) comes on as a substitute.
67' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
65' It looks like Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benie Traore (Nantes) comes onto the pitch for Tino Kadewere.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
62' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kylian Mbappe (PSG) replacing Marco Asensio.
61' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) on for Kang-In Lee.
60' 0 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Lucas Hernandez (PSG). He perfectly collected a pass from Marquinhos and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
59' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jerome Brisard no option but to blow his whistle.
58' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
57' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Neat link-up play between Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) and Tino Kadewere, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reads the game well and the move breaks down.
55' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Gianluigi Donnarumma has no trouble gathering it.
54' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save. The ball is out of play. Nantes win a corner kick.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
52' Marquinhos (PSG) meets a cross inside the box, but Remy Descamps wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
52' PSG take a short corner kick.
51' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. PSG get a corner.
50' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes. The possession of the ball – 18:82.
47' The ball is cleared after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Bradley Barcola (PSG) comes off for Goncalo Ramos.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Nantes due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' The Nantes players joy may have been justified, because referee Jerome Brisard is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
45+3' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
45+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.

45+2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a comfortable save. Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
44' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence.
44' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
43' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' Bradley Barcola (PSG) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
40' Danilo Pereira (PSG) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Rough tackle by Lucas Hernandez (PSG). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
32' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. That's a free kick to PSG.
29' Kang-In Lee (PSG) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' The percentage of ball possession is – 15:85.
24' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) commits a foul and Jerome Brisard immediately signals a free kick.
23' Marco Asensio (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Remy Descamps comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' A player from Nantes commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
21' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' Marco Asensio (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
19' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but it's cleared.
18' Lucas Hernandez received a sweet pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG), but the advance is stopped. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

11' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
10' A corner kick by PSG is thwarted by the well prepared Remy Descamps (Nantes).

10' Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Remy Descamps!
8' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Jerome Brisard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Moussa Sissoko (Nantes).
1' The first half has just begun.
Nantes will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jerome Brisard.
